description: This file handles the upload of attachments in the TestLink project. It manages both displaying the upload interface and processing file uploads, including validation, storage, and logging for attachments associated with test executions or other objects.

classes.name: stdClass
classes.description: Used as a generic object to store various GUI state parameters and input arguments.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: Template engine for rendering the upload interface, adhering to Smarty template system, used to assign variables and display templates.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Collects and returns input parameters for the upload page, including object ID, table name, and attachment title.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Verifies if the current user has permission to access the attachments page based on the configuration.
